item.text: {"actions":[{"action":"Condense verified duplicates, not merely similar images","mechanism":"Collapse matching file hashes only when license records, creator IDs, and recorded variant roles also agree.","implementation":"Add expandable duplicate rows showing copy counts and folder paths. Keep differing or unknown licenses and explicitly intentional variants separate.","check":"Identical pixels with different licenses remain separate; eligible byte-identical copies collapse; expanding reveals every original file.","risk":"Conservative grouping leaves some clutter; hashes miss differently encoded identical pixels."},{"action":"Record version relationships without merging search entries","mechanism":"Explicit, typed relationships distinguish crops, annotations, and licensed copies without treating resemblance as equivalence.","implementation":"Provide “crop of,” “annotated from,” and “licensed copy of” links between stable asset IDs. Display related-version counts without suppressing matching variants.","check":"Link two different crops to one original; verify both remain searchable and navigable, including when their filenames differ.","risk":"Incorrect relationships require correction; missing links must not imply duplication."},{"action":"Record the exact licensed file each project used","mechanism":"A project usage ledger preserves selected-file identity and historical license evidence independently of duplicate grouping.","implementation":"On asset insertion or export, record project ID, asset ID, file hash, license-record snapshot, and folder path. Require explicit file selection from duplicate groups.","check":"Use identical-pixel files with different licenses in two projects; each usage record must recover the selected file and license.","risk":"Uninstrumented imports leave gaps; flag unknown provenance rather than infer it."},{"action":"Precompute search grouping and load details on demand","mechanism":"Index-time group keys and relationship summaries avoid file inspection and version traversal during first-page requests.","implementation":"Add grouping fields to the existing index; retrieve paginated group representatives and separate variants. Fetch member lists only upon expansion; version grouping updates.","check":"Benchmark first-page loading against the one-second limit on all 12,000 assets, including duplicate-heavy queries; verify grouping does not underfill pages.","risk":"Index capabilities may limit grouping; measure before enabling, and retain ungrouped fallback."}],"abstention_reason":""}
